en.headline: City Kids Christmas Fair returns to Mid-Levels campus today
en.dek: The not-for-profit preschool opens its free annual fundraiser from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Grade II listed building on Borrett Road.
body: City Kids Preschool and Playgroup is holding its annual Christmas Fair today at its Mid-Levels campus. The event runs from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Grade II listed building at 12 Borrett Road and is open to the public with free admission and no registration required.

Children can take part in a bouncy castle, climbing frame, festive arts and crafts, face painting and games. Organisers have indicated that Santa may make an appearance. Adults can browse a Christmas market featuring local retailers, with a Feather and Bone barbecue stall, a coffee cart and a parent-run bake sale also on site. A raffle is included among the activities.

The fair is the largest annual fundraiser for the not-for-profit school, which was established in 1984 and offers programmes for children from 10 months to 5.5 years. Proceeds support the preschool's operations. The school said the event is intended for families beyond its own community.

zh.headline: City Kids聖誕嘉年華今午半山舉行 免費開放公眾參與
zh.dek: 非牟利幼稚園於波老道二級歷史建築校園舉辦年度籌款活動，上午十時至下午二時，無需登記。
body: City Kids幼稚園及遊戲小組今日在其中環半山校園舉辦年度聖誕嘉年華。活動於波老道12號二級歷史建築舉行，由上午十時至下午二時，公眾免費入場，毋須預先登記。
小朋友可玩彈床、攀爬架、節日手工藝、臉部彩繪及遊戲。主辦方表示聖誕老人或會到場。成年人可逛本地零售商的聖誕市集，現場亦有Feather and Bone燒烤攤、咖啡車及家長自製烘焙義賣，並設有抽獎活動。
這是該非牟利學校最大的年度籌款活動。學校於1984年成立，為十個月至五歲半兒童提供課程。籌得款項將支持幼稚園運作。校方表示活動歡迎非校內家庭參加。
